Discover a world of creativity with "Incredible Art: Fantastic Realm"! Immerse yourself in a collection of HD, full-color pictures that bring to life magical landscapes and enchanting creatures. This relaxing coloring game offers a soothing escape, letting you paint your way to tranquility with just a few taps. Whether you're an experienced artist or new to coloring, find joy in every stroke and create your own masterpieces. Unlock new images and explore endless possibilities in a realm of imagination. Dive into "Incredible Art: Fantastic Realm" and color your way to relaxation!

[list]
[*] Relax with easy and intuitive gameplay
[*] Big full color HD pictures
[*] Incredible soundtrack
[/list]

what reviewers say
pennmom36, 5\5 stars:
There's no doubt that Graphium Studios picks the most "Incredible Art" images for every new release, hands down! Y'all know how much I love unicorns, so I just had to give this new game a whirl. I gotta tell ya; I really wasn't expecting anything other than a simplistic Paint By Numbers scenario ...boy was I surprised!
If painting games aren't your thing, you'll probably want to pass on this one. If you want a relaxing clicking game that transforms a black-and-white sketch into a vibrant picture that practically comes to life before your eyes, this is it. 
Graphium Studios added a little feature twist to this new series (hint hint). You still have the traditional option to click on a numbered area or color pallet to fill in each area, OR you can click the mouse scroll wheel on a specific area to pull up the correct pallet color, then simply left-click to fill in the color automatically. I really liked this feature because it allowed me to complete entire sections versus having to search all over to find all the areas in numerical order. Once you get the hang of it, you can go on a clicking spree and watch areas come to life with all the colors of the rainbow.🎨
Very nicely done, boss!

notes.title: Technical Update # 5
notes.content:
What's New:
1. Improving pieces edges 

These screenshots below demonstrate what this change was all about: piece edges were quite rough on big displays.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625600/4622240dc138a2e7fa2f14563ec5177613328fbf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625600/258d43d9c916b9fc8b10484509b566c8d651eb89.png[/img]

after the improvement, they look better:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625600/abecbcf59438ef551fb3d9c251d41739599721c8.png[/img]

But now you may encounter an inconvenience. It occurs when you load an old saved puzzle: if that game was played in large cuts now there will be gaps between the completed pieces.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2710980336 

The only solution I can suggest at the moment is to restart the game. We're really sorry about this, but rolling back or creating a patch can cause new problems for those who made saves after this change. We hope for your understanding as we are still in early access.

Special thanks [b]aphfid[/b] for reporting this bug!
